svg.title: Metal fabricator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as metal fabricator, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: An L-shaped metal angle section stands beside crossed tin-snips blades with two separate hand loops. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face.
